'''Xianchen''' is an NPC in [[Jinzhou]]. She is a member of the [[Pioneer Association]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Xianchen:''' I've tried every way, but I can't persuade him. What should I do... Rover, you came at the right time. Help me think of a solution.
:{{DIcon}} What happened?
:'''Xianchen:''' It's about my junior, [[Zhuyi]]. He recently joined the Pioneer Association and is now working as an intern photographer.
:'''Xianchen:''' According to the regulations, new members are required to participate in the regular "Fireside Chats" to share and learn the history and culture of the Pioneer Association.
:'''Xianchen:''' The recent adventure story was about the Icebreakers, who ventured into places far and between, like the distant polar oceans, the revived volcanoes, and the Great Rift Valley after [[the Lament]] occurred.
:'''Xianchen:''' They reported about nature's warning signs that they spot around the world and became the first witnesses of countless powerful [[Tacet Discord]].
:'''Xianchen:''' After hearing these stories, Zhuyi suddenly became restless and applied to the Association to join the next expedition to the unchartered danger zones.
:'''Xianchen:''' I'm worried that he's moving too fast and might make the mistakes I made before.
:'''Xianchen:''' To be honest, when I was young, I was just as hotheaded as him. Always at the forefront of the team.
:'''Xianchen:''' Later, in one of the missions, I rushed forward without properly surveying the terrain and accidentally fell into a cave.
:'''Xianchen:''' As a result, I injured my thigh, and since then had to gradually retire from the field. Now I'm starting to think about transferring to support.
:'''Xianchen:''' What if he makes my mistake again?
:'''Xianchen:''' Rover, if you have a solution, you must tell me.
{{Dialogue End}}
